## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** Builds are mod folders: launch_game(mod=...) relaunches and the player picks the native character again. XeniaAdapter has no save_state, so session_swap cannot keep the moment. Doc: loading another body arc mid-round is not supported by the engine.

**Pick whip: none.** Ctrl+click picker is an item list (items.json) -> give_now, not an on-screen pick. World pickup classes (uIt...) known by DTI but no live instance and no camera projection; capabilities active_target_detection=false; pick_ram has no xbox360 RAM layout.

**Live controls:** re6 tool: give_now, set_slot, remove_item, live_inventory, set_loadout/auto, infinite_health/ammo, auto_qte, unlock_all, revert_all; session Loadout dialog + offer_controls toggles. merc_live_controls is Switch-only; game_mod points RE6 at job_re6.

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- No live body swap: a new build needs a relaunch and re-picking the native character; Xenia adapter has no save state, so no keep-the-moment session_swap.
- Untested whether the proven live sResource load (uWp arcs) can load a modified uPl body arc into a round; doc claims the engine does not support it.
- No active-character detection: which native slot/costume is playing is not read (loadout record char/costume bytes exist but are not wired).
- No pick whip: needs an xbox360 MAIN_RAM layout in tools.MAIN_RAM, a camera/view matrix and an entity list (enemy array unmapped).
- RAM map partial: round timer, score, kills, combo, enemy array, menu state unmapped; player position offset disagrees (+0x50 map vs +0x2C0 re6_x360.py).
- Enemy-family swaps and source_proportions / Smash cast builds never verified in a live round; skinning is rigid single-bone, no .lmt retarget.
- MercMode backend xbox360 verified=False; 2026-10-22 jobs 495c71b2439d48ee / f5a8831bef23496e: Xenia opened no window on the i9.
